Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.gl

Class ProcessingGpuMeasurementSession

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.gl.ProcessingGpuMeasurementSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class ProcessingGpuMeasurementSession extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Capability-driven GPU measurement session for Processing/JOGL.

Timer-query backends are never trusted merely because a counter exists. Before a timer backend is used for normal profiling, a small number of synchronized probes verifies that the reported GPU duration fits inside the CPU envelope that completely contains the same OpenGL workload. The qualification decision is cached per active GL context and policy so a benchmark warm-up can qualify the backend once and a subsequent statistics reset does not repeat the synchronization inside the measured window.

When GpuTimerPolicy.ARCHITECTURE_AWARE cannot obtain a qualified timer query, the session may fall back to OpenGL fence completion. Fence measurements are intentionally reported as GpuTimerBackend.FENCE_COMPLETION: they are CPU-observed GPU completion latency, not a timer-query GPU execution duration.
